item1.question: Do the students get paid?
item1.answer: Payment is not required. Students can participate without compensation, and completed projects can include a participation badge or certificate. Additional rewards can also be arranged when needed.

item2.question: Who designs the mission?
item2.answer: Share your market question, job description, or practical project with us. Internie turns it into a structured mission and manages student sourcing, submissions, and project operations.

item3.question: How do you make sure the work is any good?
item3.answer: We review both the final output and the steps that led to it. Milestones, intermediate deliverables, deadlines, and feedback history make each student's execution process visible.

item4.question: What does it cost?
item4.answer: Pricing depends on the project scope, duration, number of participants, and level of operational support. Book a call and we will recommend a suitable starting plan.

item5.question: Can we hire the students afterward?
item5.answer: Yes. Companies can continue discussions with suitable students after the project, subject to the student's agreement and the company's standard hiring process.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: aim (hereinafter referred to as the “Company”) processes personal information lawfully and manages it securely in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act and other applicable laws to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

In accordance with Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act, the Company establishes and discloses this Privacy Policy to inform data subjects of the procedures and standards for personal information processing and to handle related grievances promptly and smoothly.

section1.description: The Company collects and uses personal information for the following purposes during membership registration or service use.

Email, password, social login member identifier, name, email, profile photo, mobile phone number, etc.
Destroyed without delay upon membership withdrawal

Name, affiliation, role, team information, program participation information

section2.title: 2. Processing of Personal Information of Children Under 14
paragraph: As a rule, the Company does not target children under the age of 14 and does not collect or use personal information of children under the age of 14.
The Company verifies users’ age requirements during membership registration and service use, and membership registration or service use may be restricted if a user is under the age of 14.

If the Company confirms that it has unknowingly collected personal information of a child under the age of 14, it will take necessary measures, such as deleting the personal information without delay or restricting its use.

section3.title: 3. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
paragraph: The Company may provide personal information of data subjects to third parties as follows when necessary for service operation.

When providing personal information, the Company takes necessary measures, such as providing required notices or obtaining consent, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act and other applicable laws.

institution.title: 1) Provision to Institutions Participated in by Users

rows: Operating institutions, host institutions, or responsible institutions of programs in which the user participates or to which the user belongs

Participant verification, program operation, attendance management, assignment operation, evaluation and feedback provision, activity history management, and completion, selection, and performance verification
Name, affiliation, team information, role, attendance information, assignment submission status and submissions, evaluation results, feedback, peer evaluation results, voice transcripts
Until the end of the relevant institution’s program operation period or until the retention period under applicable laws and the institution’s operational policies

legalProvision.title: 2) Provision Under Laws
legalProvision.description: The Company may provide personal information in accordance with applicable laws in any of the following cases.
list: Where the data subject has given separate prior consent
Where there are special provisions in laws or it is necessary to comply with legal obligations
Where it is necessary for the urgent interests of the life, body, or property of the data subject or a third party
Where there is a lawful request from an investigative agency or other authority under applicable laws

permissionNotice.title: 3) Notice on Permission-Based Access Within the Service
paragraph: For program operation, the Company may grant the responsible staff or operators of an institution in which the user participates permission to access the participant’s personal information and activity information.
In such cases, the scope of accessible information is limited to the minimum necessary for program operation purposes.

section4.title: 4. Outsourcing of Personal Information Processing
section4.description: The Company may outsource personal information processing tasks as follows to ensure smooth handling of personal information-related work.

rows: Amazon Web Services, Inc.
Provision of system development and operating environment for service provision
OpenAI, L.L.C.
Speech-to-text conversion, summaries, or AI feature provision

section4.footer: When entering into outsourcing contracts, the Company reflects necessary matters in the contracts and supervises processors so that personal information is processed securely in accordance with applicable personal information protection laws.

section5.title: 5. Overseas Transfer of Personal Information
section5.description: The Company may transfer some personal information collected during service use overseas as follows.

rows: OpenAI, L.L.C.
The United States and other overseas infrastructure regions operated or processed by OpenAI
Voice files, text extracted from voice (transcripts), prompts entered by users, and response results
Speech-to-text conversion (STT), text summarization, and AI feature provision
During processing for OpenAI service provision and for the period under OpenAI’s relevant policies or contracts

paragraph1: When overseas transfer is necessary, the Company provides required notices in accordance with applicable laws and takes necessary protective measures so that personal information is processed securely.

According to OpenAI’s official documentation, API data residency requires separate configuration, and even when data residency is configured, system data may be processed and stored outside the selected region.
paragraph2: ※ If the Company applies OpenAI API data residency separately in the future, this section may change depending on the actual applied region and processing scope.
According to OpenAI’s official documentation, API data residency is configured at the project level and may not apply to some system data that is not customer content.

section6.title: 6. Procedures and Methods for Destroying Personal Information
section6.description: When personal information becomes unnecessary due to expiration of the retention period, achievement of the processing purpose, or other reasons, the Company destroys the personal information without delay.

list.title: Destruction procedure
list.paragraph: The Company selects personal information for which a reason for destruction has occurred and destroys it according to internal procedures.

list.title: Destruction method
children: Information in electronic file format is deleted by a method that prevents recovery or reproduction.
Information recorded in paper documents is shredded or incinerated.

section7.title: 7. Rights and Obligations of Data Subjects and Legal Representatives and How to Exercise Them
section7.description: Data subjects may exercise the following rights related to personal information protection against the Company at any time.
rights: Request to correct or delete personal information
Request to suspend processing of personal information
Request for explanation, objection, and review regarding automated decisions
section7.paragraph1: Data subjects may exercise the above rights through in-service features, email, or the customer center. When a data subject makes a request, the Company will take necessary measures without delay in accordance with applicable laws.
section7.paragraph2: Through features provided within the service, data subjects may directly handle the following matters.
paragraph3: For rights that are not directly provided within the service, data subjects may submit requests by email or through the customer center.

However, requests for access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing may be restricted under applicable laws, or where such requests may infringe on another person’s personal information or rights.

section8.title: 8. Measures to Ensure the Security of Personal Information
section8.description1: The Company takes the following measures to ensure the security of personal information.
measures: Administrative measures: Establishment and implementation of internal management plans, employee training, management of access rights to personal information, and separate operation of administrator privileges

Technical measures: Secure storage of passwords and authentication information (hashing), access control, operation of security programs, creation and management of access records for personal information processing systems, and encryption during transmission
Physical measures: Access control for personal information processing systems and data storage spaces
section8.description2: The Company applies encryption measures to the following sections to ensure secure processing during personal information transmission.
encryptionScopes: All data transmission sections of web and app services
Interface sections between internal and external systems
Database backup transmission sections and administrator page access sections

section9.title: 9. Installation, Operation, and Refusal of Automatic Personal Information Collection Devices
paragraph: The Company may use cookies or similar technologies to maintain login status and authenticate members within the scope necessary to provide the service.
The Company may also use related SDKs to provide Kakao Login and Google Login features.

list.title: Collected items
list.body: Cookies or session information for maintaining login status

list.title: Purpose of use
list.body: Provision of essential features such as login maintenance, member authentication, and account linking

list.title: How to refuse
list.body: Users may refuse cookie storage through browser settings. However, if cookie storage is refused, use of some services may be restricted.

section9.footer: The Company does not operate advertising cookies or third-party behavioral information collection features.

section10.title: 10. Criteria for Additional Use and Provision
paragraph: As a rule, the Company uses and provides personal information only within the scope consented to by the data subject.

However, where personal information may be additionally used or provided without consent under Article 15(3) or Article 17(4) of the Personal Information Protection Act, the Company comprehensively considers the following matters.
criteria: Whether it is related to the original purpose of collection
Whether additional use or provision is foreseeable in light of the circumstances of personal information collection or processing practices
Whether it unfairly infringes on the interests of the data subject
Whether security measures such as pseudonymization or encryption have been taken

section11.title: 11. Processing of Pseudonymized Information
section11.paragraph1: The Company may pseudonymize and use personal information so that a specific individual cannot be identified when necessary for statistical compilation, scientific research, service quality improvement, and similar purposes.
section11.paragraph2: In such cases, the Company pseudonymizes only the minimum necessary items and takes necessary protective measures such as separate storage and access control to prevent re-identification of pseudonymized information.

section12.title: 12. Matters Concerning Automated Decisions
section12.paragraph1: The Company may perform automated or semi-automated processing during service operation. Examples may include participation rate calculation, late submission determination, comprehensive score generation, recommendation of excellent participant candidates, and generation of summary drafts.
section12.paragraph2: The Company uses these results as reference information and operates the service so that final decisions that significantly affect data subjects are made after human review.
